notes.title: Update 0.7.6
notes.content: [p]- A global AI has been introduced, triggering an enemy invasion scenario in all star systems. Now you can participate in battles for the system: defend it or lose it, as well as recapture points that have already been captured, destroying enemy stations and ships. [/p][p]- Balancing ships and improving their dynamics for smoother and more realistic controls. [/p][p]- Improved AI behavior in combat, making confrontations more interesting and challenging. [/p][p]- Fast and furious mode is implemented by pressing Tab for fast movement.[/p][p]- Improved guns and their information systems to increase accuracy and efficiency. [/p][p]- Added a more visible entrance to the station to make it easier to navigate. [/p][p]- Redesigned the game launch process for a smoother start. [/p][p]- Track rings have been replaced with updated models with improved graphics. [/p][p]- Directional light indication is implemented in the track rings, which facilitates navigation. [/p][p]- There are anomalies in various systems, such as radiation zones and areas with high or low temperatures, adding variety and new tactical opportunities. [/p][p]- Mining of asteroids has been introduced: they can be destroyed by missiles and loot can be collected.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688088/caef83171a6f88e0cc586cc2464e7a2059cb0ff6.png"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: - A global AI has been introduced, triggering an enemy invasion scenario in all star systems. Now you can participate in battles for the system: defend it or lose it, as well as recapture points that have already been captured, destroying enemy stations and ships.

tags.balance_change: - Balancing ships and improving their dynamics for smoother and more realistic controls.
- Improved AI behavior in combat, making confrontations more interesting and challenging.

tags.feature: - Fast and furious mode is implemented by pressing Tab for fast movement.

tags.balance_change: - Improved guns and their information systems to increase accuracy and efficiency.

tags.feature: - Added a more visible entrance to the station to make it easier to navigate.
- Redesigned the game launch process for a smoother start.
- Track rings have been replaced with updated models with improved graphics.
- Directional light indication is implemented in the track rings, which facilitates navigation.
- There are anomalies in various systems, such as radiation zones and areas with high or low temperatures, adding variety and new tactical opportunities.
- Mining of asteroids has been introduced: they can be destroyed by missiles and loot can be collected.

notes.title: Update 0.7.5
notes.content: [p]In this update, we have:[/p][p]- Fixed an issue that caused the game to freeze on high-resolution and 4K monitors. [/p][p]- Fixed critical bugs to improve stability. [/p][p]- Optimized the universe and location generation processes for faster loading and smoother performance. [/p][p]- Ensured that the interface displays correctly on high-resolution and 4K monitors, with all elements scaled appropriately to avoid small and difficult-to-read icons. [/p][p] Thank you for your support and feedback![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688088/4aef5e9b3a8f692c7c603f9e35c81a64e90c6d8a.jpg"][/img][/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue that caused the game to freeze on high-resolution and 4K monitors.
- Fixed critical bugs to improve stability.
- Ensured that the interface displays correctly on high-resolution and 4K monitors, with all elements scaled appropriately to avoid small and difficult-to-read icons.
